posts.text:
Gas prices are rising toward $5 a gallon because of the reckless Republican war of choice in Iran.

Enough.

House Democrats will continue to respond decisively to the Supreme Court decision gutting the Voting Rights Act.

We will never let far right extremists rig the midterm elections and beyond.

Gas prices were under $3.00 a gallon before the reckless Republican war of choice in the Middle East. 

Today it is $4.45.

You deserve better.

nbcnews.com/business/consume…

The economy is a mess, gas prices are out of control and a reckless war of choice has been started in the Middle East.

Regime change is coming to the House of Representatives in November.

Do you need a hug?

Be Best.

The reckless war of choice in the Middle East is raising gas prices and cratering our economy.

Republicans in Congress don’t give a damn.

Shameful.

Do something to lower the high cost of living that is crushing the American people.

Meanwhile.

If I said it, I meant it.

Pete Hegseth just testified that Democrats in Congress who oppose the reckless war of choice are a bigger enemy than Iran.

Why does this malignant political hack think we work for him?

Video

The Trump administration is the most corrupt in American history.

Why is the President allowed to act like an organized crime boss?

The Supreme Court gave him blanket immunity in 2024.

Congress must investigate.

My statement in connection with today’s corrupt Supreme Court decision.

We will not rest until the John Robert Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act is the law of the land.

And we end the era of voter suppression in the United States once and for all.

Voter suppression is a way of life for Donald Trump and far right extremists on the Supreme Court.

Republicans know they cannot win a free and fair election in November and so they are desperate to rig it.

We will never let them succeed.

Actually, Iran did sign a nonnuclear deal in 2015 under the leadership of President Obama.

You blew it up.

Then plunged America into another reckless and costly war of choice in the Middle East.

Gas prices are out of control, community-based hospitals are closing in rural America and the Trump Tariffs have made your life more expensive.

Things aren’t going well in this era of far right extremism.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

The Strait of Hormuz is closed, gas prices are soaring and billions of taxpayer dollars have been wasted.

How is this reckless war of choice working out for the American people?

America will not be lectured about civility by far right extremists in Congress.

Particularly those who provide aid and comfort to hundreds of violent rioters who brutally beat police officers on January 6.

There will be ample time to vigorously debate the issues of the day.

Now is a time to unify.
